name: Toyoura Minori
source:
Manager of "Blue Comet" who is nicknamed Minorin by both customers and her coworkers. She knows a lot about anime and manga.

She is nicknamed "Minori" and insists that customers call her by that name.
Her style and slightly eccentric personality make a strong impression on everyone.
Although she seems to be just having fun and laughing behind the counter, she is actually a reliable manager who takes care of the entire store and all customers.
People are curious whether she acts the same way outside of the store as well.

She has a wide knowledge of manga, anime, and games, and can engage in any topic of conversation.
